materials.content: Watercolor and graphite on paper mounted on paper board
Watercolor and graphite on moderately thick, cream, slightly textured wove paper, mounted to cardboard (Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: By 1915 ?, gifted by the artist, Georgia O’Keeffe (Madison, WI, Abiquiu, NM, and New York), to Berthold Sauthoff (Madison, WI); after 1956, through inheritance to Hermine Sauthoff Davidson [daughter] (Madison, WI); December 1981, gifted to the Elvehjem Museum of Art [now called Chazen Museum of Art] (Source: Chazen Museum of Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
